content_of_post_to_comment: Why. I need to work at my job lmao. Why do I get satisfaction from arguing with strangers? They will never meet me irl. They have no idea who I am, and their existence does not affect my life at all other than me looking at some pixels on my phone. It’s so stupid.
comment: The weird thing is that arguing online can scratch the same itch as debating with friends, even when the stakes are fake. There’s a little rush from defending a point, feeling heard, or proving you know something. The trap is that the brain doesn’t always care whether the argument actually mattered afterward.
